_comment: OUTPUT ONLY: p3-clean-room-probe.mjs --matrix emits this v3 challenge. Do not hand-author it. challengeId must be challenge- plus 32-128 lowercase hex and recipient.probeId must be probe- plus 32-128 lowercase hex; neither is a free-form identity carrier. Each sentinel path is the peer role's original absolute TEMP sentinel path, not a redacted alias. The coordinator matrix validates that path against known identity fragments, bootstrap TEMP/TMP launch output, SHA-256, and realpath before generation. sourceCommitment/provenance are rechecked by the coordinator validator.
